text.text_excerpt: This is the second location of Eat Well. Eat Well is the only place in New Orleans you can get a Phoritto! They're Banh Mi is my favorite in the city! These Vietnamese poboys are loaded with meat. So I get them after my workouts. I must admit when I first saw a phoritto I didn't see what the big deal was. It didn't look too appetizing to me, but all my friends told me I had to try it. I'm glad I ended up trying them cause they are pretty good. I love things with a unique flavor that I can't get anywhere else. The phoritto has just the right amount of Pho flavor without being too salty, plus the tortilla wrap adds a subtle sweetness to balance it out. You can also add hoisin and sriracha t...

Okay, this is definitely the best food vendor in Pythian Market. In my humble opinion they have absolutely the best banh mi (Vietnamese Poboys) I have tasted in the New Orleans area. They really don't skimp out on that buttery mayo. I like to add sriracha on my banh mi for an extra kick. And omfg, you know a banh mi is good when you bite into it and it is dripping of saucy goodness. The stuffed chicken wings from Eat Well are a star as well. Right after you pick up your order, there are condiments on the side. Don't forget to drizzle that sweet chili sauce over it immediately. I also tried the phoritto, I'm normally not a fan of phorittos but I thought this one was really good. The phorit...

Conveniently located next to our hotel, EatWell is inside Pythian Market. The workers were super friendly which I appreciated! I had the brisket pho and it wasn't bad! Brisket isn't my first beef choice but I decided to try it. I'll have to say it was tasty and not too chewy. The broth didn't have that deep flavor I enjoy in pho however. I also wish there was more veggies (Thai basil, green onions, onions). But overall if you need a pho fix in downtown this works! My dad had the shrimp bahn mi and from what he said it was very tasty and would order it again!
